description: Long-form reading container: a readable measure plus vertical rhythm between block children. Owns the typographic core shared with layout-columns and data-layout="columns" / "prose".

attributes.name: data-layout-measure
attributes.description: Line measure: --measure-narrow / --measure-normal / --measure-wide (45 / 65 / 80ch by default; data-fluid and the accessibility themes adjust the tokens). Released to 100% in containers narrower than 30rem.

attributes.name: data-layout-max
attributes.description: Same as data-layout-measure (the prose attribute form spells it this way). ch-based — layout-center's data-layout-max="narrow" is 40rem, this one is 45ch.

childAttributes.name: data-bleed
childAttributes.description: Break out to the full inline size of the nearest query container (main, article, section). Works centered or not; centered text bleeds symmetrically.
